title: Companies with Supply Constraints and Bottlenecks
summary: HPE, Dell, and SMCI reported severe supply chain bottlenecks in 2026, with HPE's orders outpacing revenue 3.5x. Explore the impact across key tech sectors.
body_markdown:
Companies that reported supply constraints, bottlenecks or increased lead times in the last month in call transcripts or press releases


ticker Company Name Evidence of supply bottlenecks / constraints / increased lead times Quantified impact / magnitude Source Market Cap Subsector


****HPE**** Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. Explicitly said “supply constraints continue to affect our ability to fulfill the increased customer demand,” that supply “will continue to be constrained,” and backlog remained very high. Orders growing **3.5x faster than revenue** ; record / highest-ever backlog.[Sep 2, 2026 · Earnings Call](https://platform.hudson-labs.com/company/1645590/transcript/3806854/full) **$69.03B** Communication Equipment


****LSCC**** Lattice Semiconductor Corp. Said it was “managing through the assembly test pinch point” and that lead times had increased materially earlier in the year. Lead times in some cases got to **over a year** , later brought back to the **40s** .[Aug 11, 2026 · Conference Call](https://platform.hudson-labs.com/company/855658/transcript/3790259/full) **$16.46B** Semiconductors


****DELL**** Dell Technologies Inc. Reported “spotty CPU shortages,” “shortages with disk drives,” and that “just about every product going through a leading node is constrained.” No specific dollar figure; shortages affected shipments / second-half timing.[Sep 1, 2026 · Earnings Call](https://platform.hudson-labs.com/company/1571996/transcript/3806162/full) **$338.67B** Computer Hardware


****NTNX**** Nutanix Inc. Described “significant supply chain constraints related to the pricing and availability of servers,” adding that some vendors / SKUs will have extended lead times and server supply constraints will continue. Could affect project size and timing; moderately higher percentage of orders with future start dates in FY27.[Aug 26, 2026 · Earnings Call](https://platform.hudson-labs.com/company/1618732/transcript/3802922/full) **$18.40B** Software - Infrastructure
